content:
maria gomez: Heads-up — I pushed v2p3-int4 (epoch-aware variant) to shadow 4h ago. Quick A/B snapshot below, seeing a small but consistent long-doc MRR dip. Should we tighten auto-fallback or rerun with KV warmup?

jon li: paste the numbers pls

maria gomez: ```
sample_sessions: 5120
MRR_all: baseline=0.823 -> variant=0.816 (delta -0.85%)
MRR_longdoc: baseline=0.745 -> variant=0.712 (delta -4.4%)
p(MRR_all)=0.06
latency_p95: baseline=220ms -> variant=235ms (+6.8%)
error_rate: baseline=0.12% -> variant=0.14% (+0.02% abs)
KV_cold_hits: variant higher on first-token for long docs
```

kevin park: hmm long-doc reg is notable. Not blocking promo but we should set a specific long-doc gate. auto-fallback rules need to capture slice-specific regressions (not just global MRR).

anya r: I suspect KV cache/warmup. Epoch-aware routing changes tokenization & prefix alignment slightly, so long contexts see cold-path more. Can we rerun shadow with a forced KV prewarm for a subset?

maria gomez: good call. I can re-run a 2k-session shadow with KV prewarm and also tag by epoch to compare. But we still need fallback thresholds in case we miss this in shadow.

sanjay k: proposal (conservative, automatic):
- Promote ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with stability window 2h per step
- Auto-fallback triggers (any of):
  * Global MRR_all drop <= -0.5% sustained for 30m AND p-value < 0.05
  * Long-doc slice MRR drop <= -2.0% absolute for 15m (regardless of p-value)
  * p95 latency increase > 10% for 15m
  * error_rate absolute increase > 0.1% for 10m
- On trigger: immediate rollback to previous model and open incident with telemetry snapshot

kevin park: +1 to slice-based fallback. Also suggest a "quiet-burn" requirement: before moving from 5% -> 20%, run 4h quiet burn for long-doc heavy hours to catch diurnal effects.

maria gomez: I'll add a special tag to the rollout config: `epoch_tag: v2p3-epoch12` and a traffic policy that prioritizes short-context traffic early (reduce long-doc exposure until 20%).

deploy-bot: Canary set up: model=v2p3-int4, ramps=[1,5,20,100], watches=[MRR_all,MRR_longdoc,p95,error_rate], auto-fallback=true, quiet_burn=4h (long-doc window).

jon li: thanks — sounds sensible. After KV-warm shadow rerun, let's reconvene before starting the 1% ramp.

maria gomez: agreed — I'll post a short follow-up with the warmed-shadow numbers. If warmed-shadow fixes long-doc delta to <1% we'll keep proposed auto-fallback thresholds.

kevin park: FYI add note to rollout docs: include slice-level gates & KV-warm preflight procedure. Saves us from having to chase this after promo :point_up:

anya r: tagging telemetry checklist: include first-token latency distribution and prefix mismatch metric. Those picked this up last time.

maria gomez: noted. action items: rerun warmed shadow (~2k sessions), add epoch_tag and short-first traffic policy, update rollout config with sanjay's fallback rules, and update docs. Will ping when done.

jon li: ack :thumbsup:
